AP202604011820937277.core_logic: Innolight delivered strong FY25 earnings: revenue up 60% YoY to RMB38.2bn, in line with estimates, and net profit rose 109% YoY to RMB10.8bn; GPM improved sharply to 42.6% from 34.7% in FY24 driven by continued strength in high-speed optical module shipments and higher SiPh mix, with 4Q25 revenue up 102% YoY and 30% QoQ and GPM expanding to 44.5%. The company remains a key domestic AI beneficiary supported by improving supply-chain readiness, clear leadership in pluggable modules, and further margin upside from deeper SiPh penetration. In FY26E, 800G should remain the primary shipment driver while 1.6T increasingly emerges as the key revenue and GPM growth driver. Maintain BUY with TP unchanged at RMB707 based on 28x 2026E P/E.
quotes: We continue to view Innolight as a key domestic AI beneficiary, supported by improving supply-chain readiness, clear leadership in pluggable modules, and further margin upside from deeper SiPh penetration. Maintain BUY, with TP unchanged at RMB707, based on 28x 2026E P/E.
We lift our FY27E sales/net profit forecast by 8%/12% as the Company continues to scale capacity to meet robust demand on top of enhancing cost controls.

AP202603311820918747.core_logic: 收入高增印证行业高景气度：受益于全球AI算力投资加码以及下游客户对800G、1.6T等高速率光模块需求的增长，公司4Q25单季度收入创历史新高；公司积极备货、扩产以保障未来交付，4Q25末存货账面价值127亿元同比+80%，在建工程14.22亿元同环比均大幅增长。产品高速率升级+硅光渗透率提升，公司盈利能力持续优化：4Q25单季度毛利率提升至44.48%，同比/环比+9.4pct/+1.7pct。前瞻布局下一代光互连，打开中长期成长空间：子公司TeraHop全球首发12.8T XPO光模块，并展示6.4T NPO光引擎，看好光向scale-up域渗透提升公司业绩和估值的天花板。
